test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to the field guide ‘Birds of India’ authored by Zoological Survey of India, how many bird species are there in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1331**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Zoological Survey of India (ZSI) has published a book titled ‘Field Guide, Birds of India’.
 
• It deals with 1,331 **avian species found in the country.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• It highlights quality photographs of birds, unlike other books that mainly used drawings.
 
• To promote the book, ‘Field Guide, Birds of India’, the ZSI arranged two events one of which was held in Kolkata on August 4, 2022.
 
• Another event is slated to take place on August 13, 2022, in Mumbai.
 
• The authors of the book interacted with local birders and explained to them the reason that prompted them to publish this book.
 
• In Kolkata, the event was held in the auditorium of the Zoological Survey of India while the Mumbai programme will be jointly organised by ZSI and the Bombay Natural History Society (BNHS).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Zoological Survey of India was founded on 1 July 1916 by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.
 
• It is as premier Indian organisation in zoological research and studies.
 
• Headquarters: Kolkata
